name: godot-mcp
description: Edit Godot 4 scenes, nodes and scripts, run the game and read its errors, through the live editor or headless Godot.
long_description:
Godot MCP connects Claude to a Godot 4 project on your computer. It can read and edit scenes, nodes, scripts, resources, animations, tile maps and project settings; run the game and read its errors; inspect and drive the running game (live node tree, input, screenshots, debugger); and look things up in the offline Godot class reference.

It works in two ways: with the Godot editor open (edits go through the editor and are undoable) or without it (it runs Godot headless and edits the files on disk). Both need the small godot_mcp editor addon inside your project, in addons/godot_mcp. This bundle contains the addon; to install it into a project, run `npx -y @shin2344234/godot-mcp init` in the project folder, or copy the addons/godot_mcp folder from the GitHub repository.

Everything runs locally. The server makes no network connections of its own; the editor bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 only.

project_path.title: Godot project folder
project_path.description: The folder that contains your project.godot file.

godot_path.title: Godot executable
godot_path.description: Your Godot 4 executable (Windows: Godot_v4.x-stable_win64.exe, not the _console.exe; macOS: Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot). Optional: if left empty, "godot" is looked up on PATH, which desktop apps often don't inherit, so setting it is recommended.

mode.title: Tool mode
mode.description: "full" lists every Godot tool. "compact" lists only the core tools plus a godot_tools catalog that reaches the rest, which keeps Claude's context smaller.

toolsets.title: Tool groups
toolsets.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool groups to enable, e.g. "scene,node,script,run,docs". Leave empty for all groups. Groups: core, files, scene, node, script, signal, resource, visual, anim, world, audio, project, import, export, code, docs, run, game, debug, test, editor.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes the project, so Claude can only look.

allow_eval.title: Allow code evaluation in the running game
allow_eval.description: Let godot_game_eval run GDScript inside your running game. Off by default: evaluated code can do anything the game can (files, OS calls).
